/privacy.title: Your information, in context.
/privacy.lead: Information about browsing and contact during StaneLabs' preparation phase.

sections.title: A project in preparation
paragraphs: StaneLabs is not yet incorporated as an entity and this site is informational. Before any commercial activity begins, the owner's identity and contact details will be published, along with the full privacy notice. For questions about this version, you can write to {email}.

sections.title: What happens when you browse
paragraphs: The site includes no advertising or analytics tools and no tracking cookies of its own. The page's fonts and resources are served from the same origin.

To deliver the pages and protect the service, the hosting provider and, if one is used, the network provider may process technical data such as the IP address, the requested URL and the access date. This notice does not claim that hosting keeps no logs or that browsing is anonymous.

sections.title: What happens when you get in touch
paragraphs: Share only your name, a reply email address and a general description of your inquiry. Do not send passwords, keys, confidential documents or third parties' personal data.

If the form opens a draft, sending depends on your email app and provider. If it offers direct sending, it transmits those fields to the site's API so they can be delivered by email. The application does not store inquiries in a database; the message may remain in the mailboxes and email services involved.
The content of an inquiry is used to answer it and to follow up on what you requested. It is not used to subscribe you to commercial communications.

sections.title: Retention and providers
paragraphs: The retention of messages and logs depends on the hosting and email used. Before the service opens to the public, the providers, retention periods, legal basis and any international transfers will be specified. Meanwhile, avoid sharing sensitive information through this initial channel.

sections.title: Questions about your data
paragraphs: Write to {email} to request information about an inquiry you have sent, or its correction or deletion. Describe your request without attaching identity documents upfront; if verification is needed, a proportionate means will be agreed. This informational-phase notice does not replace the controller's full information, which must be published before launch.

/security.label: SECURITY
/security.title: Responsible disclosure.
/security.lead: A clear channel to report a possible security issue on this site.

sections.title: How to report a finding
paragraphs: Write to {email} with the affected URL, a description of the problem, its possible impact and the minimum steps to reproduce it. Include an email address we can reply to.
Share limited proof and remove credentials, tokens and personal data from screenshots and examples. If the report needs sensitive information, agree on a suitable channel first.

sections.title: Scope and limits
paragraphs: This channel covers the stanelabs.com site and its own services. Third-party systems, providers or prospective clients are not part of that scope.

These guidelines do not authorize intrusive testing. Do not perform denial of service, social engineering, mass messaging, data extraction or access to other people's accounts. If you come across another person's information, stop and report the finding without copying or altering it.

sections.title: Report follow-up
paragraphs: The communication allows us to review the problem and agree on next steps. No response time, reward or bug bounty program is promised. Avoid publishing details that would allow the flaw to be exploited while its review is being coordinated.

sections.title: Channel details
paragraphs: The [security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt) file lists the contact and the location of this policy. The stated support language is Spanish. This channel is not an emergency service or a response service for third-party incidents.

/tos.label: TERMS OF USE
/tos.title: A clear scope from the start.
/tos.lead: Terms for browsing this informational version of StaneLabs, a project still in preparation.

sections.title: What this version offers
paragraphs: The site presents areas of work, a methodology and illustrative examples. StaneLabs is not yet incorporated and this version offers no online contracting. Browsing, opening a draft or sending an inquiry does not create a contract or a professional advisory relationship.

sections.title: Use of the site
paragraphs: Use the page and its contact channels lawfully and respectfully. Do not enter third-party data without authorization, do not try to access other people's accounts or systems and do not interfere with the availability of the service. Reporting possible vulnerabilities is described in the [security policy](/security).

sections.title: Content and examples
paragraphs: The deliverable examples are format demonstrations; they do not represent client work or guarantee results. The site's general information does not replace an assessment of your environment. Any future work will require a scope, an authorization and conditions agreed in writing.

sections.title: Site materials
paragraphs: The texts, design and own resources are presented for browsing. Third-party resources keep their respective licenses. The presence of a brand or a resource does not imply certification, affiliation or permission to reuse it beyond what its owner allows.

sections.title: Contact and changes
paragraphs: To report a problem or clarify a condition, write to {email}. The conditions will be updated when the owner is identified and the commercial activity is defined. You can check the contracting status in [contracting and purchases](/purchase) and how contact works in the [privacy notice](/privacy).

/purchase.label: CONTRACTING AND PURCHASES
/purchase.title: We do not accept purchases yet.
/purchase.lead: StaneLabs is in preparation. There are no products for sale, payment gateway or online contracting in this version.

sections.title: First contact is informational
paragraphs: You can raise a general need by email. That conversation is not a booking, an order or the acceptance of an offer. No payment is requested from this site.

sections.title: Before offering a service
paragraphs: The owner and their tax and contact details will be identified. A proposal must detail the scope, the necessary authorizations, the deliverables, the deadlines, the price and the applicable taxes, as well as the payment and cancellation conditions and any applicable rights. Until then, no purchases are formalized through this page.

sections.title: Payments and sensitive data
paragraphs: Do not send card details, identity documents, access keys or advance payments based on this page. If you receive a payment request claiming to come from StaneLabs, verify it through a known channel before acting.

sections.title: Where to look
paragraphs: For questions about this phase, write to {email}. See also the [terms of use](/tos) and the [privacy notice](/privacy).
